summary: Iteration 2 fully verified. 15/15 pytest backend cases pass. Frontend: login, Settings (all 20 test-ids present — SMTP fields conditional on toggle, verified after enabling), multiple webhook rows add/remove works (added a 3rd row successfully), Dashboard uptime history bars + 7d/30d toggles render correctly, and unauthenticated /status/:slug route loads with title + services without redirecting to /login. Public status page correctly hides SSH/agent secrets and honors public_page_enabled + slug matching (404 when disabled or slug mismatch). Backup export/import upserts a renamed server. Digest returns 400 when email disabled, 200 when enabled. Agent metrics >= threshold fires high_cpu/mem/disk activity + alert_state flags; values below threshold fire recovered_cpu and reset alert_state. Latency alert path executes without crash.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1010 lines — nearing the 700-line split guideline. Consider extracting settings, backup, digest, public-status, and scheduler into modules.

Public status page fetches ONLY servers/domains with public=true, but activity list is filtered by kind only, not by server. If a non-public server has activity like 'server_down', it will leak the server name in the 'message' field on the public page. Suggest also filtering activity meta.server_id against the public server id list.

_dispatch_alert swallows webhook exceptions silently; consider bubbling the per-webhook error into the /test response so users can see which webhook actually failed vs succeeded (currently only fire_webhook boolean is returned).
backup_import with replace=false does not delete resources absent from the import; documented as upsert, but noting for main agent to confirm this is intended UX.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up per-test: TEST_public_srv, TEST_backup_orig/renamed, TEST_agent_alerts, TEST_latency_smoke, TEST_public_flag. Settings mutated during tests (public_page_slug='demo', email_recipient=TEST_digest@example.com, thresholds 85/2500). Some TEST_ activity entries may remain in db.activity (auto-pruned after 7d).
